summary: Read comics added from your computer or Komga library.
page_description: Enjoy your comics on Kobo with clear page controls and support for Komga libraries.
release_notes: Preview CBZ imports, keep verified copies, and retry failed library saves. Browse longer comic shelves at every text size. Requires Cobalt 0.3.12.

steps.text: Local CBZ reading needs no service. Komga mode requires an HTTPS Komga OPDS endpoint.
For a private Komga library, install its HTTP Basic credential under the exact name komga.
